summary: Biography of Florida governor Ron DeSantis, from Little League and Yale through his Navy legal work at Guantanamo and Congress to a governorship marked by voter-suppression arrests, culture-war laws and a faltering 2024 presidential run.

his book's treatment of Dred Scott and slavery in founding history
after COVID he grips the state legislature in an authoritarian style

2023 presidential campaign and feud with Trump bring the story to release
